plan.title: Require explicitly selected surface baselines in common mode decisions

criteria.description: Mode surface mappings reject unknown modes, unknown surfaces and duplicate entries while preserving existing check modes.
CLI, Stop and pre-push reject missing, unapproved, stale and changed surfaces and accept approved unchanged surfaces; narrowed mode does not weaken pre-push.
Surface evidence changes reset the Stop repetition fingerprint.

limitations: Explicit mode_surfaces opt-in; checks remain required in every mode. No automatic extraction or approval.
Policy shrink-only aggregation is a later NARU-018 slice.
Per-resource locking is not an atomic filesystem snapshot.
No pushes, releases, tool installation or repository settings changes.
